currentContext.expansion: Acknit's FY2025-26 expansion is described as a set of West Bengal site developments rather than as a costed project plan. The Company has initiated trial production of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) on the industrial land at Falta Sector III, and has started commercial production of helmets. Expansion in the industrial land procured from WBSIDCL at Banipur Integrated Textile Park, North 24 Parganas is stated to be under process, while the Company is only planning to initiate production facilities at the Jhautala Factory. The Company was allotted a 5,000 sq. m. area in the park for Leather Goods & Allied Industries at Kolkata Leather Complex, Bantalla, South 24 Parganas, and management says it is anticipating expansion there too. Against these additions, management is evaluating the feasibility of continuing with the Wind Power Generation segment because the life of the windmill is on the verge of expiration. Enabling this diversification, the Main Object Clause of the Memorandum of Association was widened by Special Resolution, with the CIN changing from L01113WB1990PLC050020 to L32902WB1990PLC050020 with effect from 30th December, 2025. No commissioning dates, ramp timelines or rupee quantum are disclosed for any of these projects in this bundle.
